description: Testing utilities for Pipecat pipeline components, including classes and functions for testing frame processors, observers, and pipelines within the Pipecat project.

classes.name: SleepFrame
classes.description: A system frame that introduces a sleep delay in the test pipeline, used to control timing during tests.

classes.name: HeartbeatsObserver
classes.description: An observer that detects heartbeat frames from a specific processor and executes a callback when detected.

classes.name: QueuedFrameProcessor
classes.description: A frame processor that captures frames into a queue for testing inspection, while allowing frames to continue through the pipeline.

methods.name: on_push_frame(self, data: FramePushed)
methods.description: Handles frame push events, checks for HeartbeatFrame from target processor, and invokes a callback.

methods.name: process_frame(self, frame: Frame, direction: FrameDirection)
methods.description: Processes incoming frames and captures frames into the queue based on direction.

methods.name: Tuple[Sequence[Frame],Sequence[Frame]] run_test( processor: FrameProcessor, *, frames_to_send: Sequence[Frame], expected_down_frames: Optional[Sequence[type]] = None, expected_up_frames: Optional[Sequence[type]] = None, ignore_start: bool = True, observers: Optional[List[BaseObserver]] = None, pipeline_params: Optional[PipelineParams] = None, send_end_frame: bool = True, )
methods.description: Sets up and runs a test pipeline with given processor and frames, validating expected frame flow in both directions.
